claims.text: The hotel was originally the private home of an Italian duchess.

findings.quote: Originally the private home of an Italian duchess, Hotel Esencia is a place where the traditions of the past blend with the cosmopolitan art of living well today.

claims.text: Hotel Esencia is a 50-acre estate at the midpoint between Tulum and Playa del Carmen.

findings.quote: Hotel Esencia is a majestic 50-acre estate at the midpoint between Tulum and Playa del Carmen in Mexico.

claims.text: A new owner arrived in 2014, beginning a modern reimagining of the estate.

findings.quote: A new chapter began in 2014 with the arrival of a new owner and a bold, worldly outlook on how to savor paradise.
The estate’s provenance as a place of leisure for nobility is the guiding inspiration for a modern reimagining.

claims.text: Owner and art collector Kevin Wendle added rooms and filled the renewed interiors with art and antiques.

findings.quote: current owner, entrepreneur, and art collector Kevin Wendle in 2014
as well as adding rooms and sprinkling the renewed interiors with art and antiques.

claims.text: The Main House is the hotel's centerpiece, with footpaths leading out to the suites and villas.

findings.quote: The Main House remains the hotel’s centerpiece, around which footpaths lead to only 47 suites and 4 villas

claims.text: Guests are asked on arrival what morning drink they would like and when, and it is brought to them each day.

findings.quote: I particularly liked having a morning green tea brought to me at 7 a.m. each day (you are asked on arrival what you would like, when, in the morning).

claims.text: Spa treatments draw on local Mayan heritage and ingredients from the garden.

findings.quote: Treatments draw on the local Mayan heritage and ingredients from the garden.

claims.text: The pools are right by the beach and bordered by jungle.

findings.quote: Right by the beach, they are bordered by lush jungle.

claims.text: The Beach Bar is wooden, lit by candlelight, right on the edge of the beach.

findings.quote: The Beach Bar, I loved. Wooden with dim candlelight, right on the edge of the beach

claims.text: Guests can go snorkeling on the hotel's catamaran.

findings.quote: Mr. Smith, who took me out snorkeling on the catamaran, was knowledgeable and great to be with.

claims.text: In 2026, for the third year in a row, Hotel Esencia was awarded Three Michelin Keys by the Michelin Guide.

findings.quote: In 2026, for the third year in a row, Hotel Esencia was the only hotel in the Riviera Maya to be awarded Michelin Guide’s highly coveted Three Michelin Keys.

claims.text: Each year sea turtles make their nests in the bay of Xpu-Ha.

findings.quote: the immaculate bay of Xpu-Ha is a natural haven where each year sea turtles make their nests.

claims.text: The hotel sits where the Yucatan jungle meets the sands of Xpu-Ha bay, one of the remaining undeveloped shores of the Mayan Riviera.

findings.quote: This secluded oasis sits where the Yucatán jungle dissolves into the pristine sands of the Xpu-Ha bay, one of the remaining undeveloped shores of the Mayan Riviera.

claims.text: The spa has several hot tubs set in niches under a thatched palapa.

findings.quote: Several hot tubs are hidden away in niches, all under a soaring thatched palapa.

claims.text: Accommodation includes Jungle Suites with a plunge pool.

findings.quote: Hotel Esencia - Jungle Suite with Plunge Pool
Hotel Esencia - Rooftop Wellness Suite

claims.text: The hotel is 30 minutes from Tulum, on an estate midway between Tulum and Playa del Carmen.

findings.quote: 30 minutes from hip Tulum.
Hotel Esencia is a majestic 50-acre estate at the midpoint between Tulum and Playa del Carmen in Mexico.

claims.text: There are two pools of equal size, one for children and one for adults.

findings.quote: And the pools—one for children, one of equal size for adults—are lovely.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation to nearby attractions.
